name: Ticket Stub
summary: A refer-a-friend ticket whose stub is snipped off by scissors and flips over to say Copied
about: A candy-pink referral card with your code printed on a paper ticket. Pressing the stub brings in a pair of scissors that snip down the perforation, then the stub tears away, flips over to a green COPIED side and floats off while little coins pop out of the tear. The code is really on your clipboard, and a fresh stub slides back in. Below it are real Message, Email and Share links and a reward track where coins drop in as friends join. It suits referral pages, promo codes, gift links and invite rewards.
how: Press the pink COPY stub (click, tap, Enter or Space). The stub leans and the scissors appear at the top of the perforation.
The scissors snip down the dotted line while the cut opens behind them.
The stub tears away and flips to COPIED, the code letters hop and coins pop out of the tear. The code is on your clipboard.
The stub floats off with a sparkle and a new one slides in from the right on a spring.
Message and Email open your apps with the code; Share uses your device's share sheet. In the preview a friend joins now and then and a coin drops onto the reward track.
